works.name: Han Tumía de Márderos de Universe
Lord of Light y versus Balrog

podcast.title: Prolific Output and 2017 Album Goal
podcast.body: King Gisart and Elisar Wysart are exceptionally prolific, releasing new material roughly every 8 to 9 months. In 2017, they set an ambitious goal to release five albums within the year, a target considered overwhelming by many. "Para este 2017 se ponían como objetivo hacer 5 álbumes en un año."

srcs.episode: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard: ¿Pero que significa Murder of the Universe?

podcast.title: Australian Origin and Rising Popularity
podcast.body: The band is from Australia and, despite having primarily operated within alternative and independent circles, their popularity is rapidly increasing. Their growth is compared to the early stages of Arquit Fayer, a band known for being artistic, eccentric, and independent. "Es una banda australiana que todavía apenas ha salido de los tírculos alternativos e independientes, pero que la popularidad está creciendo como la espuma."

srcs.episode: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard: ¿Pero que significa Murder of the Universe?

podcast.title: Complex and Artistic Style
podcast.body: The band is recognized for its highly artistic approach and creation of complex musical pieces. Their album "Marderoth de Universe" is cited as an example of their intricate and well-crafted musical compositions. "King Gisart es un grupo muy arti, que hace cosas verdaderamente complejas."

srcs.episode: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard: ¿Pero que significa Murder of the Universe?

podcast.title: Detrimental Spoken Word Narration
podcast.body: Despite the album's strong musicality, a significant criticism is directed at the extensive spoken word narrative segments featuring a man and a woman, which are integrated with the sung tracks. These narrative portions are perceived as detracting from the musical experience, overwhelming the otherwise impressive compositions. "Un hilo argumental musical increíble, potentísimo que se cargan con unas interminables para fadas de gente hablando."

srcs.episode: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard: ¿Pero que significa Murder of the Universe?

podcast.title: Limited Interviews and Future Clarity
podcast.body: Due to their relatively emerging status, there are very few interviews or public declarations available from the band. It is speculated that a deeper understanding of "Marderoth de Universe" and its interconnected stories, particularly regarding the narrative coherence, might only become clear with the release of the third album in their 2017 series. "Tenemos muy pocas entrevistas de ellos o muy pocas declaraciones de ellos porque todavía no son tan importantes."
